levels.label: Return and recall
levels.evidence_summary: The installed extension restored three files and the active cursor after an extension-host restart, then reported a missing fixture file instead of hiding the partial restore.
levels.allowed_claim: Pre-CR can preserve and restore branch-specific editor context and reports partial restoration explicitly.
levels.forbidden_inference: Every editor, workspace type, or stale state has been verified.

levels.label: Act
levels.evidence_summary: The installed Quick Actions workspace scope exposed Run Pre-CR Check, Refresh Coverage, and Fix Setup without requiring the command palette.
levels.allowed_claim: Pre-CR exposes its core check, coverage, and setup actions directly inside its IDE workflow.
levels.forbidden_inference: All 37 registered commands are equally mature or supported.

levels.label: Prove
levels.evidence_summary: The installed extension marked one uncovered changed line, cleared the diagnostic after a focused test exercised it, and reported 100% changed-line coverage.
levels.allowed_claim: Pre-CR can identify an uncovered changed line and verify the focused repair from the editor.
levels.forbidden_inference: The standalone CLI blocked the failing state.

levels.label: CLI enforcement
levels.evidence_summary: In the PCR-3 fixture, the failing headless run returned ok=false with gateDecision=warn and process exit code 0.
levels.allowed_claim: The fixture proves detection and repair; CLI enforcement depends on policy.
levels.forbidden_inference: The observed failing fixture was blocked by the CLI.

levels.label: Distribution
levels.evidence_summary: The workflow was verified in VS Code 1.133.0 with jakye.pre-cr-suite@0.1.0 installed locally; marketplace or hosted distribution was not assessed.
levels.allowed_claim: The standalone IDE workflow was verified in an installed local VSIX.
levels.forbidden_inference: The extension is marketplace-published or generally available.
